### 结论
ViT 和 CLIP 的训练目标与监督信号存在本质差异：ViT 以**单模态图像分类的有监督标签**为核心信号，而 CLIP 以**跨模态图文配对的对比学习**为核心信号。

---

### 详细对比与原文引用
| 维度 | ViT | CLIP |
|---|---|---|
| 核心训练目标 | 大规模图像分类的有监督预训练；仅附录中探索了类似 BERT 的 masked patch prediction 自监督辅助任务 | 图文检索的对比学习预训练，优化对称交叉熵损失（InfoNCE / multi-class N-pair loss） |
| 监督信号来源 | 图像数据集的离散类别标签（如 JFT-300M、ImageNet-21k 的分类标注） | 网页规模的图文配对自然语言描述，即 natural language supervision |
| 关键机制 | 预训练后通过在目标数据集上添加 zero-initialized 线性分类层进行全微调 | 通过 joint multimodal embedding space 最大化匹配图文的余弦相似度、最小化不匹配图文的相似度，支持 zero-shot 迁移 |

#### ViT 原文证据
- 主训练范式为大规模**有监督图像分类预训练**，论文明确指出其自监督预训练探索仍显著落后于有监督预训练：“our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet... still 4% behind supervised pre-training” [vit:p9:c2]。
- 自监督仅作为附录中的初步探索：“We employ the masked patch prediction objective for preliminary self-supervision experiments” [vit:p14:c2]。
- 微调阶段通过在目标数据集上接入对应类别数的线性分类层适配图像分类任务：“zero-initialized linear layer outputting the number of classes required by the target dataset” [vit:p14:c2]。

#### CLIP 原文证据
- 预训练任务本质是**图文检索**：“CLIP’s pre-training task optimizes for text-image retrieval” [clip:p26:c3]。
- 对比学习目标的具体实现：给定批量 N 个图文对，优化对称交叉熵损失，最大化真实配对的余弦相似度、最小化错误配对的相似度：“maximize the cosine similarity of the image and text embeddings of the N real pairs in the batch while minimizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings of the N²−N incorrect pairings. We optimize a symmetric cross entropy loss” [clip:p4:c3][clip:p4:c4]。
- 核心监督信号定义为 natural language supervision：“the appreciation of natural language as a training signal. All these approaches are learning from natural language supervision” [clip:p3:c2]。
- 对比目标相比图像 caption 预测基线带来 4 倍训练效率提升：“Swapping the prediction objective for the contrastive objective of CLIP further improves efficiency another 4x” [clip:p3:c1]。

### 结论
ViT 和 CLIP 的训练目标与监督信号存在本质差异：ViT 以**单模态图像分类的有监督标签**为核心信号，而 CLIP 以**跨模态图文配对的对比学习**为核心信号。

---

### 详细对比与原文引用
| 维度 | ViT | CLIP |
|---|---|---|
| 核心训练目标 | 大规模图像分类的有监督预训练；仅附录中探索了类似 BERT 的 masked patch prediction 自监督辅助任务 | 图文检索的对比学习预训练，优化对称交叉熵损失（InfoNCE / multi-class N-pair loss） |
| 监督信号来源 | 图像数据集的离散类别标签（如 JFT-300M、ImageNet-21k 的分类标注） | 网页规模的图文配对自然语言描述，即 natural language supervision |
| 关键机制 | 预训练后通过在目标数据集上添加 zero-initialized 线性分类层进行全微调 | 通过 joint multimodal embedding space 最大化匹配图文的余弦相似度、最小化不匹配图文的相似度，支持 zero-shot 迁移 |

#### ViT 原文证据
- 主训练范式为大规模**有监督图像分类预训练**，论文明确指出其自监督预训练探索仍显著落后于有监督预训练：“our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet... still 4% behind supervised pre-training” [vit:p9:c2]。
- 自监督仅作为附录中的初步探索：“We employ the masked patch prediction objective for preliminary self-supervision experiments” [vit:p14:c2]。
- 微调阶段通过在目标数据集上接入对应类别数的线性分类层适配图像分类任务：“zero-initialized linear layer outputting the number of classes required by the target dataset” [vit:p14:c2]。

#### CLIP 原文证据
- 预训练任务本质是**图文检索**：“CLIP’s pre-training task optimizes for text-image retrieval” [clip:p26:c3]。
- 对比学习目标的具体实现：给定批量 N 个图文对，优化对称交叉熵损失，最大化真实配对的余弦相似度、最小化错误配对的相似度：“maximize the cosine similarity of the image and text embeddings of the N real pairs in the batch while minimizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings of the N²−N incorrect pairings. We optimize a symmetric cross entropy loss” [clip:p4:c3][clip:p4:c4]。
- 核心监督信号定义为 natural language supervision：“the appreciation of natural language as a training signal. All these approaches are learning from natural language supervision” [clip:p3:c2]。
- 对比目标相比图像 caption 预测基线带来 4 倍训练效率提升：“Swapping the prediction objective for the contrastive objective of CLIP further improves efficiency another 4x” [clip:p3:c1]。

5 C ONCLUSION
We have explored the direct application of Transformers to image recognition. Unlike prior works
using self-attention in computer vision, we do not introduce image-speciﬁc inductive biases into
the architecture apart from the initial patch extraction step. Instead, we interpret an image as a
sequence of patches and process it by a standard Transformer encoder as used in NLP. This simple,
yet scalable, strategy works surprisingly well when coupled with pre-training on large datasets.
Thus, Vision Transformer matches or exceeds the state of the art on many image classiﬁcation
datasets, whilst being relatively cheap to pre-train.
While these initial results are encouraging, many challenges remain. One is to apply ViT to other

2. Approach
2.1. Natural Language Supervision
At the core of our approach is the idea of learning percep-
tion from supervision contained in natural language. As
discussed in the introduction, this is not at all a new idea,
however terminology used to describe work in this space
is varied, even seemingly contradictory, and stated motiva-
tions are diverse. Zhang et al. (2020), Gomez et al. (2017),
Joulin et al. (2016), and Desai & Johnson (2020) all intro-
duce methods which learn visual representations from text
paired with images but describe their approaches as unsuper-
vised, self-supervised, weakly supervised, and supervised
respectively.

is not any of the details of the particular methods used but

these approaches are learning from natural language super-
